# AutoMate

> AutoMate is a personal vehicle management app for car, bike and scooter owners in India. Manage fuel, expenses, garage records and service reminders without vehicle Bluetooth. Record trips manually using phone GPS, or automatically after setup with compatible vehicle Bluetooth. Supported fuel payment alerts are prepared for review; FASTag toll tracking is for cars only. No extra hardware or account is needed. Records stay on the phone; there are no AutoMate servers. In closed testing on Google Play (app ID `in.getautomate.app`), Android 12 or newer.

Key facts:

- Trips start and end automatically when the phone connects to and disconnects from the vehicle's Bluetooth (car stereo, hands-free kit or the scooter's own Bluetooth). GPS route, stops, replay, city and highway split, and trip cost. Trips can also be started by hand.
- Fuel fill-ups, FASTag tolls and other vehicle payments are picked up from payment notifications (SMS, UPI, bank and FASTag apps, Gmail previews) on the phone. AutoMate has no SMS permission.
- Also: mileage (km/L) for city and highway, expenses, garage log with bills, job cards and service reminders by date, and a `.automate` backup file to move to a new phone.
- FASTag recharge opens a compatible UPI app for recipient and amount review. Balance updates from matched issuer alerts, not the payment handoff.
- Saved places show visit patterns. Trip money received tracks contributions, repayments and reimbursements alongside trip cost. Garage bills, photos and PDFs stay on the phone.
- FASTag features are for cars only; everything else works for bikes and scooters.
- Pricing: Free includes 1 vehicle and the first 50 trips. Expenses, fuel, FASTag and Garage stay free for the included vehicle. Adding another vehicle requires Monthly or Lifetime; both paid plans include unlimited vehicles and trips. Trips after 50 are saved but locked until a plan is bought through Google Play: ₹69 a month, or ₹999 once for life (launch price ₹799 until 31 December 2026). No ads.
- Privacy: no account, no analytics, no ads. Maps, addresses and some place lookups use Google services.
- Made in India. Contact: hello@getautomate.in
